cases.sentence: Поэтому давайте перейдем от основ учения о ___ к тому, что предназначено для зрелых.
cases.explain: The preposition о (about) requires the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Мы не станем опять обосновывать необходимость покаяния в делах, которые ведут к ___.
cases.explain: The preposition к (to/toward) requires the dative case.

cases.sentence: Потому что тех, кто уже был один раз просвещен, кто лично познал вкус ___ дара.
cases.explain: The genitive adjective modifies the noun in genitive case.
The adjective in dative form agrees with the noun it modifies when used with prepositions governing dative.

cases.sentence: Земля, которая приносит урожай ___, благословенна Богом.
cases.explain: The dative pronoun тому (to him/those) is governed by the implied preposition indicating the recipient.

cases.sentence: подражали тем, кто своей верой и терпением наследует ___.
cases.explain: The transitive verb наследовать (inherit) requires the accusative case for the object being inherited.
The preposition от (from) requires the genitive case.

cases.sentence: И в этих двух неизменных вещах, в обещании и в ___.
cases.explain: The preposition в (in) requires the prepositional case.

reading.ru: Поэтому давайте перейдем от основ учения о Христе к тому, что предназначено для зрелых.
reading.question: What should the readers move beyond?
options: The basic teachings about Christ to more advanced instruction
reading.correct: The basic teachings about Christ to more advanced instruction
reading.explain: The text says to 'move on from the teaching about Christ to what is intended for the mature.'

reading.ru: Потому что тех, кто уже был один раз просвещен, кто лично познал вкус небесного дара и стал сопричастен Святому Духу, невозможно опять обновлять покаянием.
reading.question: What is impossible to do for those who have fallen away after being enlightened?
options: To renew them again to repentance
To restore them to the temple
reading.correct: To renew them again to repentance
reading.explain: The passage states it is 'impossible to renew them again to repentance' if they have fallen away after experiencing the gifts of God.

reading.ru: Земля, которая пьет часто выпадающий на нее дождь и приносит урожай тому, кто ее обрабатывает, благословенна Богом.
reading.question: What happens to land that produces crops?
reading.explain: The text says that 'Land... that produces a crop... is blessed by God.'

reading.ru: Когда Бог давал обещание Аврааму, он клялся самим собой, так как нет никого большего.
reading.question: Why did God swear by Himself when making the promise to Abraham?
options: Because there was no one greater than Himself to swear by
Because it was the custom of the time
reading.correct: Because there was no one greater than Himself to swear by
reading.explain: God swore by Himself 'since he could swear by no one greater.'

reading.question: What did Abraham obtain by patient waiting?
reading.explain: The verse states 'having patiently endured, he obtained the promise.'

reading.ru: Эта надежда — крепкий и надежный якорь для нашей души.
reading.question: What is this hope compared to?
options: An anchor of the soul, sure and steadfast
reading.correct: An anchor of the soul, sure and steadfast
reading.explain: The text says 'This hope we have as an anchor of the soul, a hope both sure and steadfast.'
